title: GENERAL MILLS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: General Mills, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026, disclosing the issuance of €1.7 billion in junior subordinated notes—€1 billion of 4.750% Series A notes and €700 million of 5.250% Series B notes—both due 2056, via underwriters Barclays, Deutsche Bank, Citigroup, and J.P. Morgan.
key_points: General Mills issued €1.7 billion in aggregate principal of junior subordinated notes on April 16, 2026.
Series A Notes: €1,000,000,000 at 4.750% fixed-to-fixed reset rate, due 2056.
Series B Notes: €700,000,000 at 5.250% fixed-to-fixed reset rate, due 2056.
Underwriting syndicate led by Barclays Bank PLC, Deutsche Bank AG, Citigroup Global Markets Limited, and J.P. Morgan Securities plc.
Notes registered under Securities Act of 1933 via Form S-3 (No. 333-283277).
Filing signed by CFO Kofi A. Bruce.
